faqs.a:
The city has an open door philosophy. An employee may discuss any business related
               matter with the employee's department supervisor or management, where appropriate.
               Employees are encouraged to bring issues, suggestions, concerns to their management
               in as timely a manner as possible using the guidelines listed below.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
